# ML-Ops.org

> A comprehensive resource for understanding and implementing Machine Learning Operations (MLOps) principles, frameworks, and best practices.

ML-Ops.org provides foundational knowledge and practical guidance for building, deploying, and governing machine learning systems in production. The site covers core MLOps methodologies including CRISP-ML(Q), the MLOps Stack Canvas, and detailed workflows for data scientists and ML engineers.

## Key Topics

- MLOps
- CRISP-ML(Q)
- MLOps Stack Canvas
- ML Workflow
- CI/CD
- Model Governance
- Data Engineering
- Model Engineering
- ML Deployment
- Machine Learning Operations
- ML Lifecycle
- DevOps
- Continuous Delivery
- Model Governance

## Getting Started

- [ML Ops: Machine Learning Operations](https://ml-ops.org): Homepage introducing MLOps principles, CRISP-ML(Q), and MLOps Stack Canvas
- [MLOps: Motivation](https://ml-ops.org/content/motivation): Guide explaining business motivation and use cases for machine learning
- [MLOps: Phase Zero](https://ml-ops.org/content/phase-zero): Tutorial on Phase Zero planning using AI Canvas and ML Canvas frameworks

## Core Frameworks & Methodologies

- [CRISP-ML(Q)](https://ml-ops.org/content/crisp-ml): Reference guide for CRISP-ML(Q) standard and ML development methodology
- [MLOps Stack Canvas](https://ml-ops.org/content/mlops-stack-canvas): Reference for MLOps Stack Canvas framework and technology integration
- [MLOps Principles](https://ml-ops.org/content/mlops-principles): Reference documentation on MLOps principles, CI/CD, and best practices

## ML Development & Workflows

- [End-to-end Machine Learning Workflow](https://ml-ops.org/content/end-to-end-ml-workflow): Guide covering complete ML pipeline from data preparation to deployment
- [Three Levels of ML Software](https://ml-ops.org/content/three-levels-of-ml-software): Framework explaining data engineering, model engineering, and software release levels

## Production & Governance

- [ML Model Governance](https://ml-ops.org/content/model-governance): Guide on model governance, compliance, and production-ready ML operations
